# Re-read the data to ensure clean state
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN

# Check which rows have invalid revenue
invalid_rows = df[df['revenue'].isna()]
invalid_rows[['order_id', 'revenue']]"}
